method: Exact local-floor and alternating-series refinement of the nine-point Gram-defect proof
summary: Refines the accepted ajp88 reweighted nine-point Gram-defect proof. Exact replay of every leaf in its 48-root certificate permits the higher local floor c = 859538525913875481/10^20, with the proof tree, weights and pressures retained. At theta = sqrt(2)/2, theta^2 = 1/2 permits exact rational evaluation of inherited alternating cosine and sinc polynomials, sharpening the AM window floor. The counting formula (h-B)/(1-c) gives a strict exact improvement over the ajp88 record, about 4.72e-8 percentage points. The proof includes dyadic and cumulative bounds for distinct critical-line zeros, and the stronger simple-zero bounds. The ordinary Lean checks are rebuilt at the higher floor. Original attribution and licenses are retained.
